0022600098.text: The Pistons are 1-0 and sit 1st in the Central and 2nd in the East, while the Heat are 0-1, 5th in the Southeast and 14th in the East. Detroit is without Taurean Prince, who is day-to-day with a personal reason and is listed as a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Pistons lost the season series 1-2, including a 121-110 loss in Miami on March 8, 2026.
